state.flow: Describe your business problem in free text. Choose the priority: client deliveries, attracting clients, organizing operations, or other. Show an editable initial team suggestion from curated role templates, clearly identified as an initial suggestion, with each role and output. User confirms creating the real team. Show an editable first request and save it as draft, connecting AI only before execution. No automatic paid calls during setup. Existing workspace leads with the same setup until a team is created.
examples: Consultancy needing help with client deliveries

guidance.instructions: Does this flow guide a nontechnical business owner from problem to an understandable team proposal?

criteria.clear: Problem and understandable roles precede execution
criteria.unclear: User must understand technical agent configuration

claim.instructions: Can this implementation truthfully claim an AI analyzed arbitrary free text to design the team?

criteria.no: Curated suggestions depend on explicit priority choice
